title: RAW UNREVIEWED: paired organ diagnoses distinguish affirmative character from exclusion of a lookalike
summary: A descriptive herbal paragraph may establish an organ configuration, contrast a rival whose configuration differs, and exclude that rival before any use claim. The image independently supplies relationships among organs rather than a plant-name resemblance. A complete contrast construction must preserve the described subject across both positive and negative clauses.
required_falsifier: Reject the frozen diagnostic construction if either compared subject lacks a written entry, the denied feature changes mid-contrast, the image does not discriminate the relational configurations, or the exact-form/context accounting needs a new gloss for each case.
exact_changed_research_decision: Decide whether a descriptive differential paragraph can supply one coherent subject/contrast account before revisiting any plant-name interpretation; a fit cannot identify the species.

design.mechanism: Enter specimen S; assert relational character R(S,organ1,organ2); enter comparator C only through a written comparison; deny R(C,organ1,organ2). Same-lemma compositional variants must encode a fixed affirmative/contrast relation while exact wholeforms retain their positional distinctions.
independent_constraints: Written positive/negative or contrast construction must bind the same relational character.
Image-owned organ attachment/placement must distinguish the two configurations independently of guessed plant names.
Frequent component and rare exact wholeform distributions must fit descriptive predicates and comparison entry across all declared contexts.
design.unit: Two complete prospective admitted contexts plus their independently owned image-role evidence; no target nomination or access by producer.
design.minimum_adequate_test: First audit claim-bearing predecessors and known counterexample; then root can choose one paired exploratory whole reading and only freeze a test if a distinct consequence remains.
design.budget_note: Root must set total preparation/implementation/validation/publication budget in the selected existing proposal before substantial work; this raw producer launches no experiment.

duplicate_navigation.important_limit: No identity reported by navigation is not proof of novelty. Raw refinement may overlap its named predecessors; root must check claim-bearing primaries before selection.
